payload.poisoned_connection_hypothesis: SQLite poisons a connection once it returns SQLITE_CORRUPT; mcp-server holds long-lived connections (uptime 57m at detection). That would explain all three observations at once: intermittent across agents (which pooled connection you draw), non-transient within one agent cycle (same poisoned connection), and intact-but-unwritable unrelated tables. TESTABLE PREDICTION AND TRAP: restarting mcp-server will make the symptom disappear while leaving tree 180 corrupt — that is almost certainly how the 07-19 / 07-30 / 08-06 occurrences were each closed, which is why this is now the 4th+. Verify with quick_check AFTER any restart, not with a clean error log.
